A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] served as the '''security chief''' aboard [[Durga Besadii Tai|Durga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[Darksaber (superweapon)|''Darksaber'']] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]]. When [[General/Legends|General]] [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]] infiltrated the [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], Durga wanted to execute the Twi'lek, but accidentally executed the [[Unidentified Weequay navigator|Weequay navigator]] instead. However, he was soon killed along with the rest of the crew when the ''Darksaber'' was destroyed in the [[Hoth asteroid field/Legends|Hoth asteroid field]].
